purpose: Prove the constitution's terminal product proposition through a finite repeated-natural-task cohort: sustained goal-level delivery, lower user orchestration burden than source-bound ad-hoc baselines, real demand-driven capability and carrier lifecycles, and live cross-host open reference delivery. v0.2 remains an immutable bounded calibration milestone and cannot satisfy this program by inheritance.

increments.observedProblem: Independent pre-freeze review reproduced a P1 authority defect: a task registration commit can precede the commit that changes program.normativeProfileBinding from unfrozen to frozen because the verifier proves only that the profile and cohort-protocol artifacts predate registration. A later program edit can therefore retrospectively label an already-registered task as prospective.
increments.hypothesis: Requiring every registration commit to have exactly one parent whose committed product/program.json contains the exact current frozen normativeProfileBinding can prove that the declared profile and cohort protocol were frozen before registration without trusting Git timestamps or creating a registry, runtime or behavioral outcome validator.
increments.falsifier: The repair trusts Git dates or self-reported time, accepts an artifact-then-registration-then-freeze history, accepts a merge registration or a parent program with an unfrozen or different binding, requires future task identities or outcome evidence, or changes any v0.2 artifact or claim.
increments.stopCondition: Regression tests reproduce and reject artifact-then-registration-then-retrospective-freeze history and merge-parent ambiguity; the legitimate artifact-then-frozen-program-then-registration order and planned zero-evidence state remain valid; the current program returns to ready and unfrozen with O1-O5 zero, canonical local and hosted checks pass, and no profile, task registration, evidence or temporary residue is created.
